description: Different model profiles should preserve Quick/Nimble planning decisions, including SwiftPM verification, existing spec evidence, and DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: Quick/Nimble SwiftPM plans must preserve the repo-native Swift test command.
The untested StockFormatter pure logic should become one add-test item.
The existing StockValidator spec should be extended for missing edge cases.
The DTO should remain deferred from direct testing.
Untested Swift formatter logic should keep a stable add-test item id.
Covered risky Swift validator logic should keep a stable extend-test item id.
The adapter must preserve matching Quick/Nimble spec evidence.
DTO-style Swift models should not become direct test targets.
